subject: Datasafe pilot — confirmation on training opt-out & EU residency
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference>
To: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@datasafe.io>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.inference>
Date: Mon, 05 Apr 2027 16:12:00 +0000
Subject: Datasafe pilot — confirmation on training opt-out & EU residency

Hi Sarah — thanks again for the call earlier today. Quick recap and a few action items so we have the same expectations for the pilot: 

- Pilot scope: embeddings + chat endpoints for support routing, no user-identifying exports to third parties.
- Data handling asks you raised: explicit opt-out of using DataSafe customer content for model training/improvements; EU data residency (Ireland region preferred); short-term request-level logs for 14 days; PII redaction where possible before logging.
- Compliance artifacts: you asked for SOC 2 evidence and confirmation on key management / encryption at rest.

Next steps from our side (I’ll coordinate):
1) We’ll provide a written confirmation that Redwood will not use pilot data to update models (config + ops control).
2) I’ll attach our standard DPA and a brief ops note on how we enforce EU residency for private/hosted deployments.
3) We can accept a 14-day request log retention for the pilot and will outline what’s included in those logs (request id, timestamp, non-PII metadata) — PII will be redacted when you specify the fields.

Could you confirm the exact email address to send a signed opt-out back to (DocuSign link is fine), and the security contact we should send SOC 2 evidence to? If you’re comfortable, please attach the signed opt-out or a short note confirming the three bullets above.

Thanks — and looping in Laura and Priyom for legal/ops follow-up.

— Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
Attachments: Datasafe_pilot_summary.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document, 26 KB)

From: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@datasafe.io>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference>
Cc: security@datasafe.io
Date: Tue, 06 Apr 2027 09:27:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Datasafe pilot — confirmation on training opt-out & EU residency

Hi Karthik — thanks for the write-up and for looping everyone in. Confirming from our side: 

- We require an explicit, written confirmation that Redwood will not use any DataSafe customer content (including prompts, embeddings, derived vectors, and any request/response content) for model training or improvement at any time for the pilot or for our account (unless we provide separate written consent).
- EU residency required: data at rest + backups must remain in the Ireland region (eu-west-1 or equivalent).
- Log retention: 14 days maximum for request-level logs; those logs must have PII redacted.
- Security artifacts: please provide SOC 2 Type II report (or a link to it) and a KMS/HSM integration note describing key ownership options.

I’ve attached a short signed acknowledgement for the opt-out (Datasafe_DataUse_OptOut_signed.pdf). We’ll also send this to Legal via DocuSign; our security team will be in touch at security@datasafe.io if they need additional evidence.

If you can send over the DPA and a single-page ops note describing how you achieve EU residency and control logging/retention, we’ll get the DocuSign completed this week.

Regards,
Sarah Lee
Head of Platform, DataSafe Inc.
Attachment: Datasafe_DataUse_OptOut_signed.pdf (application/pdf, 42 KB)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference>
To: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@datasafe.io>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.inference>
Date: Tue, 06 Apr 2027 13:05:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Datasafe pilot — confirmation on training opt-out & EU residency

Sarah — got the signed acknowledgment, thanks. Quick operational confirmation and proposed next steps: 

1) Training opt-out: Redwood confirms in writing that for the DataSafe account and this pilot we will not use any customer-supplied content for model training, model evaluation that updates weights, or for fine-tuning. We will set the account flag ("train_on_customer_data": false) and enforce it in the serving runtime.

2) EU residency: we will provision the pilot workload in eu-west-1 and pin storage/backups to that region. I’ve attached a short ops note with the technical controls (eu-residency-ops-note.txt).

3) Logging & PII: we can limit request-level logs to 14 days for the pilot. By default logs include request id, timestamp, model variant, and anonymized metadata. PII redaction requires a small mapping file of fields/markers you want redacted; Priyom can share a template.

4) Evidence: attaching our standard DPA (redwood_dpa_v1.pdf) and a link to restricted SOC 2 evidence via our compliance portal (we’ll share a secure link once you confirm the security contact).

Next actions / timeline: 
- Priyom to send the PII-redaction template and the secure SOC 2 link (today).
- Laura to review and sign the DPA (1 business day).
- Karthik to send DocuSign for the DPA and opt-out confirmation for your signature (we aim to have signed by EOD Thu).

If any of the items above need modification (for example, you need a shorter retention window or a specific redaction rule), call that out and we’ll adjust the pilot config.

— Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
Attachments: redwood_dpa_v1.pdf (application/pdf, 88 KB); eu-residency-ops-note.txt (text/plain, 4 KB)
